nodePolicy.barrierProvenance: No source-backed blocking topology is asserted in the offline Gate 2 GLB, so no FFS_Barrier_* nodes are emitted.

runtimeTopologyBarrierPolicy.corridorCarvePolicy: Browser/runtime may derive visible gameplay masses from checked surface-offset samples only when every approved person-route corridor is carved to at least its contract width. Austen's two verbatim traced connectors must remain unblocked at every vertex and segment.
runtimeTopologyBarrierPolicy.truthBoundary: Derived masses express gameplay topology from measured above-ground surface returns. They do not identify individual trees, trunks, species, buildings, fences, or cadastral boundaries.
runtimeTopologyBarrierPolicy.offlineGlbRelationship: The offline GLB retains one non-colliding FFS_Anchor_LidarCanopyProxy context mesh and emits no FFS_Barrier_* nodes. Runtime barriers are a separate visible-and-colliding derivation governed by this policy.

nodePolicy.structureProvenance: No buildings or exact campground structures are asserted. All semantic markers are visibly classified placeholders.

sourceClassDefinitions.measured: DTM elevation, lidar surface height, orthophoto registration, scale, and coordinate transforms.
sourceClassDefinitions.austenObserved: First-person operational topology: camping eligibility, vehicle ritual, parking outcome, and the existence of the two canopy-hidden pedestrian connectors.
sourceClassDefinitions.austenTraced: The two pedestrian connector centerlines Austen drew over the source-locked orthophoto on 2026-08-25.
sourceClassDefinitions.interpreted: Tier-scale open ground, road centerlines traced from public imagery, and surface screens; field confirmation required.
sourceClassDefinitions.invention: Festival placements, interactions, night transformation, and exact proposed coordinates beyond what public terrain or Austen's first-person account establishes.

limitations: The 4 m review mesh is a measured downsample of the 1 m source DTM; recorded full-grid interpolation errors bound the offline visual-review surface only. Browser/runtime collision must use the full 1 m DTM.
Austen's connector vertices are verbatim orthophoto traces, not centimetre-accurate field survey.
Road, campsite, parking, zone, and marker coordinates retain their Gate 1 evidence classes and are not promoted to building or cadastral truth.
Surface-evidence proxy masses are non-colliding lidar-height context and do not identify individual trees or structures.
